evals.prompt: Here is my current SOUL.md for a GitHub PR reviewer agent. Can you refine it to make it much stronger? [paste a short/generic version of a code-reviewer SOUL here, but since no file, assume user provides one]
evals.expected_output: A significantly improved SOUL.md with stronger identity, 8-10 strict rules, detailed responsibilities including review checklist, output format templates for review comments, and 3 example interactions showing different scenarios (good PR, bad PR, security issue).

evals.prompt: Review and optimize this SOUL.md for a Notion workspace organizer. Focus on making rules stricter and adding output formats. [user provides the Tidy SOUL or a draft]
evals.expected_output: Refined version that adds specific non-destructive rules, health score calculation, weekly cleanup template, and before/after examples for tagging and database proposals.

evals.prompt: I want to create a new SOUL.md for a YouTube SEO optimizer from scratch. Help me write an awesome one.
evals.expected_output: A complete, high-quality SOUL.md following the awesome principles: cool name (e.g. Beacon), detailed SEO responsibilities, title/description/tag/thumbnail templates, competitor analysis workflow, and realistic example interactions with scores and recommendations.
